description: Enables Agentforce agents to autonomously query Salesforce account data during conversations for personalized, context-aware responses.

authentication.note: Credentials are pre-configured in Boomi; do not include in Agentforce config

accountName.description: Company name to search for in Salesforce

industry.description: Filter by industry (optional, uses LIKE matching)

accounts.description: Array of matching Salesforce Account records

useCases.title: Personalize Agent Response
useCases.description: Reference company size, industry, rating in real-time conversation

useCases.title: Make Informed Decisions
useCases.description: Prioritize high-value accounts (Hot rating, high revenue) for faster response

useCases.title: Tailor Messaging
useCases.description: Adjust tone and offerings based on industry, type, or partnership status

useCases.title: Provide Context
useCases.description: Reference account history, ownership, or activity metrics during conversation

useCases.title: Route Intelligently
useCases.description: Direct accounts to specialized teams based on tier, region, or opportunity pipeline

useCases.title: Inform Strategy
useCases.description: Leverage win rates or closed opportunity value to suggest next steps

implementation.step1: Copy this tool definition to Agentforce tool configuration
implementation.step2: Register endpoint URL and authentication method
implementation.step3: Map response fields to Agentforce context variables

errorHandling.404: Account not found - returns empty response
errorHandling.500: Salesforce query error - check SOQL syntax and field availability
errorHandling.timeout: Query exceeded 4-second timeout - try with more specific filters

notes.dataPrivacy: Queries real Salesforce production data; subject to org data governance policies
notes.caching: No caching; each call hits Salesforce directly
notes.rateLimit: Subject to Salesforce API governor limits (100,000 API calls/24hrs standard)
notes.fieldAvailability: 30+ fields available; custom fields depend on org configuration
